**Verdict: PASS.** I reviewed DG1 round-11 candidate `sha256:e5cc6ef982ba7d53ed80138c0cbaa0119bcfe8dcaad4e324b5dafdb6431afeb8` (freeze commit `32e6478`) and found nothing new.

The candidate ID recomputes identically in the repo and in a full disposable clone. HEAD moved during my run (d8eb695 → 4caa00b), but only because the runner committed the other reviewers' records, and the ID stayed the same. I did not open those records. Since round 10, only test, harness and docs files changed; no product runtime file did.

**Findings I verified (both closed as verified):**
- **F-DG1-214 (Medium):** the web unit tests now pass on Node 24.
  - Node 24: 302/302 overall, unit-web 110/110, and none of the "Expected signal to be an instance of AbortSignal" errors.
  - Node 22: the same result.
  - The two files that failed in round 10 pass 37/37 on Node 24, including the F-DG1-004 and F-DG1-210 regression tests.
  - To prove the new test environment is what fixes it, I switched it back to the standard jsdom setup in the disposable clone. That reproduces the exact round-10 failure on Node 24 (12 of 110 fail) and still passes on Node 22.
- **F-DG1-215 (Low, same route as F-DG1-132):** the change is documentation plus a pinning test, which is one of the closures the finding itself allowed.
  - The code comments and decision D-055 now say `setEngine` is banned in "every SPELLED form", and name the namespace-enumeration route as accepted residual (a).
  - `architecture.test.ts` passes 109/109 on both Node versions. It pins E1–E4 as not flagged and still flags S1–S3.
  - My own probe passes 31/31 on both Node versions. It flags 20 spelled forms. The enumeration forms reach `setEngine` with no lint violations, exactly as documented.
  - I left F-DG1-132 for its original reporter (code-security) to close.

**Re-confirmed:**
- **F-DG1-009:** the integration suite passed 200/200 three times (twice on Node 22, once on Node 24), with no 57P01 errors and no "terminating connection" lines in the server logs.
- **F-DG1-210:** the full end-to-end suite passed 22/22 in English and Arabic on both Node versions, and my independent spec passed 2/2 with no page reloads.
- **REQ-DLV-042:** the installer acceptance log is still the 14-case run (14 passed, 0 failed).

**Other checks, all passing:**
- **Build and static checks:** build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI (33 operations), no-CDN, formatting, contrast.
- **Contract suite:** 9/9, including getBrandingTokens.
- **Audit trigger:** UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE are all rejected, and the row count is unchanged.
- **Acceptance suites:** A12 14/14, A13 5/5, A14 5/5, A18 clean start (with a real offline install) and A20 token propagation.
- **Accessibility scan:** no serious or critical issues on 15 English and 15 Arabic screens.
- **Gate validator:** `--register DG1`, `--pipeline` and `--reconcile` all pass, and the record matches the schema.
- **Requirements:** all 12 are complete, and none of their cited evidence files is missing.

**What I did not cover:**
- **`pnpm deps:verify`:** it needs registry access and this sandbox has no network, so I stopped it. It isn't in my assignment, so I didn't list it as a check or claim it passed.
- **PostgreSQL 18:** my disposable database was PostgreSQL 16.13, while CI uses 18, so I didn't test against 18.
- **My probe's first attempt:** it wrongly expected one extra form (X1) to go unflagged. The lint does flag it, which is the safe direction. I corrected the probe and re-ran it, and kept the first-attempt logs.

New findings: none, so no Critical, High or mandatory issues.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG1/round-11/qa-verifier.json`
- `reviews/DG1/round-11/qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `reviews/DG1/round-11/qa-verifier.md`
- `test-evidence/DG1/qa/round-11/` (logs and screenshots)
- `test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/dg1-r11-setengine-probe.test.ts`

The disposable clones and the copied package store have been removed.
